images.filename: Long Beach California from Airplane looking North.jpg
images.caption:
Photograph of Long Beach. California taken from an airplane looking northward. Also seen in the photograph are parts of the Port of Long Beach, the entire city of Signal Hill and parts of surrounding areas.
This photograph was taken on January 4th, 2013 and was modified by increasing the contrast and adjusting levels. It was resized to half the original size due to the low quality of the original image.
